name: ENGL 3653
title: Maritime Literature Since 1800
description: (Also offered as MAST 3653.) Maritime fiction and non-fiction since 1800: Melville, Conrad, Douglass, and others.
requirement_description: ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011; open to sophomores or higher. Not open for credit to students who have passed ENGL 3650.
